_meta.description: Amazon Associates and FTC requirements checked against this site. 'status' is the site's compliance state as built. Every row links to the official source.

rules.requirement: State 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' clearly and prominently on the site.
rules.site_implementation: Disclosure bar on every page and beside each affiliate link.
rules.verified_quote: “You must clearly and prominently state the following … on your Site …: ‘As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.’”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Show prices and availability only if Amazon serves the link, or the data comes from Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No Amazon prices are published. Flag F-02.
rules.verified_quote: “your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not display Amazon customer reviews or star ratings unless obtained through Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No star ratings or review counts are published. Flag F-02.
rules.verified_quote: “You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass; the lettered list sits under heading 6, so 6(t) is correct (F-17)

rules.requirement: Every Special Link must include the Associates ID (tag) as a URL parameter.
rules.site_implementation: User-supplied short links are used as given. The tag does not appear in the resolved URLs. Flag F-03.
rules.verified_quote: “you must include your Associates ID or ‘tag’ (appearing as XXXXX-##…) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not use a link shortening service in a way that makes it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site.
rules.site_implementation: The links use link.amazon, Amazon's own short domain, and are labelled as Amazon links. Flag F-04.
rules.verified_quote: “You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not include Amazon trademarks in domain names, subdomains or tags.
rules.site_implementation: Site domain is kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4, which contains no Amazon mark.
rules.verified_quote: “You will not … include any trademark of Amazon or its affiliates, or a variant or misspelling … in any domain name, subdomain name, in any ‘tag’ or Associates ID…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass; section reference matches the corrected numbering

rules.requirement: Do not buy paid search advertisements on keywords that include Amazon trademarks.
rules.source_ref: Commission Income Statement, Section 2(c); Participation Requirements, Section 6(e)-(f)
rules.site_implementation: No paid advertising is connected to this site.
rules.reverified: Not re-read by arena/8908f0b3-zone4 in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not assign sub-tags to individual end users.
rules.site_implementation: No per-user tracking or sub-tags are used.
rules.reverified: Not re-read by arena/8908f0b3-zone4 in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not offer incentives for using Special Links, and do not place Special Links in customer reviews or Amazon content.
rules.site_implementation: No incentives or rewards are offered; no links are placed on Amazon.
rules.verified_quote: “You will not offer any person or entity any consideration, reward, or incentive … for using Special Links.” — “You will not include any Special Links in any content that you place on an Amazon Site…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not display price-comparison data without showing both the lowest new and the lowest used price on Amazon.
rules.site_implementation: No prices are displayed, so no comparison is shown.
rules.verified_quote: “if you choose to display prices for any Product on your Site in any ‘comparison’ format … you must display both the lowest ‘new’ price and, if we provide it to you, the lowest ‘used’ price at which the Product is available on the Amazon Site.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not collect, use or store product listings, descriptions or prices beyond the license; do not use data mining or robots.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: Verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool. Only identifiers and a few spec fields are kept. Flag F-11.
rules.verified_quote: The licence “does not include … any collection and use of any product listings, descriptions, or prices; any derivative use of any Amazon Service or its contents … or any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass; canonical node is GLSBYFE9MGKKQXXM

rules.requirement: Do not use AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: Planned AI content automation is NOT built. Flag F-12.
rules.verified_quote: “You will not, and will not allow any third party to, use AI-generated content from the Amazon Services to, directly or indirectly, develop or improve large language or multimodal models, machine learning models or related technology.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass; wording restored in full

rules.requirement: Disclose a material connection clearly, placed with the endorsement, in simple language that is hard to miss.
rules.source_ref: FTC Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers, 'How to Disclose'
rules.site_implementation: The Associates disclosure sentence is shown on every page, including next to each affiliate link.
rules.verified_quote: “Place it so it’s hard to miss. The disclosure should be placed with the endorsement message itself.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous and placed near each affiliate link, not hidden on another page.
rules.source_ref: Associates Central help: 'Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?'
rules.site_implementation: The disclosure sentence appears directly under each 'Open Amazon link' button, in the same card or row.
rules.verified_quote: “your link-level disclosure must be: 1. Clear. … 2. Conspicuous. It should be placed near any affiliate link or product review in a location that customers will notice easily. They shouldn’t have to hunt for it.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Commission income is paid on Qualifying Revenue, which excludes shipping, gift-wrap, handling, taxes, service charges, credits, rebates, card fees and bad debt.
rules.site_implementation: Applies to any future earnings model. No earnings are calculated, because the category rate is unverified (F-01).
rules.reverified: Not re-read by arena/8908f0b3-zone4 in the second pass

rules.requirement: A Qualifying Purchase requires a Special Link click, a 24-hour session and an order within 89 days of the click (for cart purchases), and excludes search-engine-displayed and redirecting links.
rules.site_implementation: Links are direct, with no redirect or intermediate page. Search-engine display is not controlled by this site.
rules.reverified: Not re-read by arena/8908f0b3-zone4 in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not use Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology without express prior written approval from Amazon.
rules.site_implementation: No machine-learning model is trained or developed with Special Links or Program Content on this site. Any future AI work needs written approval. Flag F-12.
rules.verified_quote: “You will not, without … express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not artificially generate clicks or impressions on your Site or create Sessions on an Amazon Site, whether by robot, software program or otherwise.
rules.site_implementation: The site generates no clicks or sessions and has no click tracking. Automated click tracking is not built (F-19).
rules.verified_quote: “You will not artificially generate clicks or impressions on your Site or create Sessions on an Amazon Site, whether by way of a robot or software program or otherwise.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Any agent that accesses Program Content must identify itself in the user-agent ('Agent/[agent name]'), must not conceal that it is an agent, and must not circumvent access controls.
rules.site_implementation: No agent is built. AI automation is not connected to Amazon data (F-23).
rules.verified_quote: “Agents must: In all HTTP/HTTPS requests, identify that the request is from an Agent and disclose the name of the Agent by including the following in the request’s user agent string: ‘Agent/[agent name]’ … Not conceal or obfuscate that any access, use, or interactions are from an Agent…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: If Amazon text (Product Advertising Content) is displayed, include the Section 2(k) disclaimer in plain view.
rules.site_implementation: The disclaimer is not shown. Decision pending (F-24).
rules.verified_quote: “If you display Product Advertising Content consisting of text on your application, you will include the following disclaimer in plain view to end users of your application: ‘CERTAIN CONTENT THAT APPEARS [IN THIS APPLICATION or ON THIS SITE, as applicable] COMES FROM AMAZON. THIS CONTENT IS PROVIDED ‘AS IS’ AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE OR REMOVAL AT ANY TIME.’”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass; the disclaimer is now shown in the footer of every page on this site

rules.requirement: Do not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or Amazon's policies, promotions or prices.
rules.site_implementation: Every marketing sentence on the content page is tied to the verified listing title, brand field or category breadcrumb; anything the record does not support is left out and listed under 'Cannot claim'.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not give the Site price tracking or price alerting functionality unless Amazon agrees otherwise.
rules.site_implementation: The pricing analysis the brief asks for is limited to noting that prices are withheld; no tracker, alert or historical chart exists. Flag F-25.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 6(y): “Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: When a Special Link points at a page with a Product list, the Site must carry additional original content relevant to that link, and links must point to Products.
rules.site_implementation: Each link points at a Product detail page and sits beside original research, verification rows and category notes rather than a bare list.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “Special Links must link to Products … When linking to pages with Product lists you must have additional original content on your Site that is relevant to the Special Link.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Display Special Links only after applying to and being accepted in the Associates Program, and never tie a sub-tag to a specific end user.
rules.status: Needs review (no approved account confirmed here)
rules.site_implementation: Marketing copy is held as drafts inside a research site rather than published as monetised pages; no per-user tracking or sub-tags exist. Flag F-27.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(a): “After you have applied to the Associates Program, you are permitted to display Special Links on your Site.” Section 2(b): “Under no circumstances may you associate any sub-tag … with a specific end user of your Site.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not describe an experience with a product you have not tried, and do not make claims that need proof the advertiser does not have.
rules.source_ref: FTC Disclosures 101, What Else to Know
rules.site_implementation: Drafts contain no first-person testing language and no performance, health or durability claim; scripts/verify.py fails the build if a testing phrase appears.
rules.verified_quote: FTC, Disclosures 101: “You can’t talk about your experience with a product you haven’t tried” and “You can’t make up claims about a product that would require proof the advertiser doesn’t have…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Remove any link or reference to a limited-time promotion from the Site as soon as that promotion ends on the Amazon Site.
rules.site_implementation: No price, deal or promotion text is published, so nothing expires; a real campaign needs an expiry step. Flag F-26.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “You must remove from your Site any links and related references to limited time promotions as soon as that promotion on the relevant Amazon Site ends.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not use Amazon's name or trademarks in meta tags or hidden text, and do not frame Amazon content.
rules.source_ref: Conditions of Use, License and Access
rules.site_implementation: Meta descriptions describe the research in plain language; there is no hidden text or keyword stuffing, and no Amazon mark appears in the domain.
rules.verified_quote: Conditions of Use, License and Access: “You may not use any meta tags or any other ‘hidden text’ utilizing Amazon’s name or trademarks without the express written consent of Amazon.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Do not use Creators API, PA API or Data Feeds to aggregate, analyse, extract or repurpose Product Advertising Content, or for training or fine-tuning a model, without express prior written approval.
rules.site_implementation: No API aggregation or analysis pipeline exists; product research here is a small, manually verified record rather than an automated harvest. Flag F-30.
rules.verified_quote: IP License, Section 2(e): “You will not, without our express prior written approval, access or use Creators API, PA API or Data Feeds for the purpose of aggregating, analyzing, extracting, or repurposing any Product Advertising Content … or in the direct training or fine-tuning of a machine learning and/or foundational model.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: If pricing or availability data is shown, put a date/time stamp beside it and include the price-disclaimer sentence.
rules.site_implementation: No prices or availability are published, so no stamp is required; recorded because it constrains any future pricing feature.
rules.verified_quote: IP License, Section 2(i): “You will include a date/time stamp adjacent to your display of pricing or availability information…” and must include “Product prices and availability are accurate as of the date/time indicated and are subject to change…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Product Advertising Content other than images may be stored for caching only up to 24 hours and must then be refreshed; ASINs may be stored indefinitely.
rules.site_implementation: This site is a static snapshot regenerated on each build, and listing text is quoted only to identify the product. A refresh cadence is not yet scheduled. Flag F-29.
rules.verified_quote: IP License, Section 2(h): “You may store other Product Advertising Content that does not consist of images for caching purposes for up to 24 hours, but if you do so you must immediately thereafter refresh and re-display the Product Advertising Content… You may store individual Amazon Standard Identification Numbers (ASINs) for an indefinite period.”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass

rules.requirement: Use Product Advertising Content only on a site whose principal purpose is advertising an Amazon Site and driving sales, and link each use to the relevant Product page.
rules.source_ref: Associates Program IP License, Section 2(c)(i) and 2(c)(iii)
rules.site_implementation: Every page of this site is about the listed products and links to their Amazon detail pages; no Amazon content is used to promote other retailers.
rules.verified_quote: IP License, Section 2(c)(i): use “only in a lawful manner … that … ha[s] the principal purpose of advertising and marketing an Amazon Site and driving sales”; 2(c)(iii): “You will link each use of Product Advertising Content to, and only to, the relevant page of an Amazon Site…”
rules.reverified: Confirmed verbatim in the second pass
